need = image area × pixel ratio (contain / cover)
sticky per item: no downgrade after rotation
high: page in view · normal: neighbors · low: others
pages just outside the render window
200: write file (new name if changed), evict LRU
error: stale copy, else the remote URL
decode queue: one decode per task, urgent first
requests of pages that left the window dropped
